verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents loading data from other databases and object storage, including step-by-step guidance for PostgreSQL/MySQL tables, querying S3/GCS/Azure, storing S3 credentials as secrets, and a dbt-duckdb integration for transformation. The pack shows no SaaS-app connectors and no ETL/ELT ingestion partners, so coverage is limited to databases, cloud storage and dbt. Flights (scheduled Python jobs) is a building block for writing your own ingestion, not a connector, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented SaaS app connectors, partner ETL/ELT ingestion integrations (e.g., managed pipeline tools), a broader connector catalog, independent hands-on corroboration.
